description:
MINI CAT XL 500W ELECTRIC MINI BIKE Limited Edition. Available ONLY here at Big Cat Bikes
The 2021 Mini Cat XXL 750W E-Bike features an aluminum frame that houses a new 48V 13Ah Lithium Ion battery. This powers a 750W geared rear hub motor that delivers more torque which will enhance your electric bike experience on any terrain. The new frame on this e-bike was designed with the rider in mind. New to the 2020 model is the addition of front suspension. The top tube swoops down slightly which will allow riders to get on and off the bicycle easier. Still featuring monster 4.0" tires, the Mini Cat XXL fat tire e-bike is the ideal bike for riders who are seeking an alternative means to traditional cycling, which in many cases can be limited to road and light off-road use. The Mini Cat XXL allows riders to ride along the sand, mud, dirt trails, snow and regular road conditions with ease! Easily Accommodate riders from 4'9" to 6'2".

About The Mini Cat electric bike
Still featuring monster 4.0" tires, the Mini Cat XXL fat e-bike is the ideal bike for riders who are seeking an alternative means to traditional cycling, which in many cases can be limited to road and light off-road use. The Mini Cat XXL allows riders to ride along the sand, mud, dirt trails, snow and regular road conditions with ease! Big Cat® E-Bikes come standard with a LCD display that allows riders to unleash the full potential of your Big Cat. Get real time speed, battery life, and distance readings. Set the pedal assist level or top speed that best fits your riding style and riding conditions. *range depends on rider, weight load, charge, and sometimes weather conditions **speed can vary between user, depending on weight load, charge and sometimes weather conditions

Long range so you don't have to worry about losing power during your ride. 30 - 60 miles on a single charge
Both throttle and pedal assist. You have the convenience of both. If you need that extra boost to get over that hill, just twist the throttle.
Smaller footprint with 20 inch wheels means it's easier to transport and lighter. With a 750W motor and a 48v lithium ion battery, this bike is a mini beast!
Bafang BF RMG06 750-Watt geared rear hub motor
4 inch fat tires mean you can ride this on any terrain.
Big Cat Electric Bikes come standard with Tektro 203mm Mechanical disc brakes.
Specs
Frame Mountain Bike Design – Aluminum Frame Size 18″ Frame Finish Metallic Green, Metallic Orange- 7 layer paint Brakes Tektro 203MM Mechanical Disc Brakes, Front & Rear Tires 20"X4″ Rims Aluminum-Alloy 36 spoke Derailleur Shimano Acera 7 Gear Battery Volts / Amps Lithium-Ion 48V 13Ah super powerful Black Casing Range Up to 50 Miles (Range depends on rider, rider weight, terrain, wind, charge & sometimes weather conditions) Max Speed 25 to 28 mph Seat Folding Adjustable seat Seat To Floor 32" to 39" from top of stem to floor E-Bike Motor Powerful Bafang 750W 48V Hub Drive Charging Time 4-6 Hours (Max. 6 Hours) Battery Life Up to 2000 Cycles or about 4 years Weight With Battery 40 Weight Capacity 295 Lb Cargo rack available Pannier Rack Dimensions Functions Pedal Assist On-Demand Throttle with kill switch Controller King Meter KM-529 (5 Level PAS) Lights Super Bright LED lights on front and Rear Crankset 170mm Arms – 12 Magnet Cadence Sensor Suspension Front suspension fork included Warranty Click to view the full warranty information User Manual Click to download the users manual FULL SPECS
